PRIVACY POLICY

Last Updated: October 15, 2025

1. INTRODUCTION
D NA Digital Consultancy (“we,” “us,” or “our”), a DBA of Dna Web Solutions, Inc., is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or engage our professional services. We operate with a military-grade commitment to accountability; we do exactly what we say we’ll do, especially regarding the security of your data.
2. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

We collect information that allows us to deliver high-performance consulting and technical solutions. This falls into two categories:

  • Voluntary Information: This includes names, email addresses, and project details provided via our “Start the Conversation” contact forms or consultation bookings.

  • Technical Data: We automatically collect IP addresses, browser types, and usage patterns via cookies to optimize the performance of our “architectural plates” and digital experience.

3. HOW WE USE YOUR DATA

Your data is the blueprint for our engagement. We use it strictly to:

  • Facilitate strategic AI roadmapping and technology leadership.

  • Develop and deploy custom software, mobile apps, and CRM intelligence.

  • Communicate project milestones and delivery enablement.

  • Ensure the security and resilience of our digital infrastructure.

4. DATA SHARING & THIRD PARTIES

We do not measure success by the size of our database, and we certainly do not sell it. Data is only shared with third-party partners (such as AWS for cloud hosting or GoHighLevel for CRM management) when essential to execute the mission you have hired us to perform. All partners are vetted for proactive risk anticipation and high-performance integrity.

5. YOUR DATA RIGHTS

YOUR RIGHT TO ACCESS: You have the right to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. You may also request that we correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your information at any time.

6. COOKIES & TRACKING

We use functional and analytical cookies to ensure our website’s glassmorphism and motion effects perform at peak efficiency. You can manage these at any time via our Cookie Preferences dashboard.

7. DATA SECURITY

Integrity is our operating system. We implement industry-standard technical and organizational measures—including hardware cold storage for digital assets when applicable—to protect your information from unauthorized access or structural failure.

8. CONTACT US

If you have questions regarding this policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
